blind.description: A small copper saucepan consisting of a cylindrical pot body and a single dark metal or plastic handle extending straight out from the rim. The exterior is polished metallic copper, the interior is lined with reflective stainless steel, and the handle is dark grey metal attached with visible rivets. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous, resting flat directly on the floor with no plinth.
blind.from_above: A circular orange-copper ring surrounding a silvery metallic bottom interior, with a single straight dark handle projecting upwards toward the top edge of the frame.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/15th the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 4–5 inches tall), with the pot diameter roughly 6–8 inches across.
